Part of the case for a 50% jump in Axon Enterprise (AXON) stock rests on a business you may not connect with it: counter-drone systems, a category Axon added at the end of 2024. You probably still think of Axon as the maker of TASERs and body cameras. The stock has also gone the wrong way, falling 43.5% over the past year while the S&P 500 gained 14.0%. Yet a rise that size is no stretch for this stock. In August 2025 it closed 105.8% above the latest price, and in nine of the ten calendar years from 2016 to 2025 it rose 50% or more from one close to a later close within that year. That is the contradiction: a new business growing inside a stock that has fallen. So how big has counter-drone become at Axon?

Axon’s Platform Sales More Than Doubled, Led By Counter-Drone

Counter-drone already shows up in Axon’s sales. Platform solutions revenue grew 123% to $150 million in fiscal Q2 2026, and management said much of that rise came from Dedrone, its counter-drone business. Platform solutions as a whole brought in about 17% of Axon’s $904 million in revenue for the quarter. Management said counter-drone has quickly become a consistent contributor to results.

So far, counter-drone demand has also reached past a single event. On the August 5, 2026 call, management said the World Cup was certainly a surge, but that it is also seeing the demand at data centers and corporate campuses. The day before that call, Axon was named a participant in the $1.5 billion DHS program for counter-drone systems, making it one of a handful picked from 55 or 60 applicants. Management said it is still a little unclear how much of that program Axon will capture.

Axon Still Earns Little Profit On Growing Sales

Profit, not sales, appears to be the worry. Axon’s fiscal Q2 2026 earnings per share missed estimates even as revenue topped them, news reports said on August 6, 2026. Axon earned an operating margin of 5.2% that quarter, up from a small loss a year earlier. Over the twelve months to June 2026, though, its operating margin was under 1%, against 25.2% at Motorola Solutions over its own latest four quarters.

Axon’s counter-drone growth is still weighing on its margins. Management said a larger mix of newer products, which are still scaling, held back gross margin in the quarter, and that Axon is absorbing that mix as it scales counter-drone and other new businesses.

The cash has not arrived yet either. Axon’s free cash flow was an outflow of about $56 million over the first half of 2026. Management guides to $450 million for the full year, with strong seasonality in the fourth quarter, so the second half has to bring in more cash than the full-year guide. Management tied the weak cash to the inventory Axon is building to meet demand, and expects that spending to moderate after 2026.

What Could Slow Axon’s Counter-Drone Sales?

Demand could slow after the World Cup, which management called a surge. Axon could also win only a small part of the DHS program, though management said that program is not the only way money will be spent on counter-drones. Margins could slip first, too: after a tariff refund in fiscal Q2 2026, management said in August that it expected its adjusted EBITDA margin for fiscal Q3 2026, a quarter Axon will report in November 2026, to reflect higher memory costs, with no tariff refund, before it rises again in the fourth quarter

If either the counter-drone demand or the cash falls short, a buyer is left holding a stock priced at 171.1 times trailing earnings, against 22.6 for the S&P 500, on a business that earns little profit. Counter-drone demand has so far reached past the World Cup, but the cash has not yet arrived, so Axon’s free cash flow in the report it is expected to give in November 2026 is the number to watch.

Now you know Axon Enterprise better. Our purpose is to inform you so you can decide for yourself, and acting on one stock, in either direction, carries its own risk.

Axon Enterprise (AXON) 股票上涨 50% 的部分原因在于一项你可能与之没有联系的业务：反无人机系统，这是 Axon 在 2024 年底添加的一个类别。你可能仍然认为 Axon 是泰瑟枪和随身摄像机的制造商。该股也走上了错误的道路，过去一年下跌了 43.5%，而标准普尔 500 指数却上涨了 14.0%。然而，对于这只股票来说，如此规模的上涨并不算困难。 2025 年 8 月，该股的收盘价比最新价格高出 105.8%，而在 2016 年至 2025 年的 10 个日历年中，有 9 年该股从一个收盘价到该年晚些时候的收盘价上涨了 50% 或更多。这就是矛盾所在：新业务在下跌的股票中增长。那么 Axon 的反无人机规模有多大呢？

在反无人机的带动下，Axon 的平台销售额增长了一倍多

反无人机已经出现在 Axon 的销售中。 2026 财年第二季度，平台解决方案收入增长 123%，达到 1.5 亿美元，管理层表示，大部分增长来自其反无人机业务 Dedrone。整个平台解决方案带来了 Axon 本季度 9.04 亿美元收入的约 17%。管理层表示，反无人机已迅速成为业绩的持续贡献者。

到目前为止，反无人机的需求也已经超过了单一事件。在 2026 年 8 月 5 日的电话会议上，管理层表示，世界杯肯定会带来激增，但数据中心和企业园区的需求也随之增加。在那次电话会议的前一天，Axon 被指定为国土安全部 15 亿美元反无人机系统计划的参与者，使其成为从 55 或 60 名申请人中挑选出来的少数公司之一。管理层表示，目前还不清楚 Axon 将获得多少该项目的份额。

Axon 因销售额增长而利润微薄

令人担忧的似乎是利润，而不是销售额。 2026 年 8 月 6 日的新闻报道称，尽管收入高于预期，Axon 2026 年第二财季的每股收益仍低于预期。该季度 Axon 的营业利润率为 5.2%，高于一年前的小幅亏损。不过，截至 2026 年 6 月的 12 个月内，其营业利润率低于 1%，而摩托罗拉解决方案最近四个季度的营业利润率为 25.2%。

Axon 反无人机业务的增长仍在影响其利润率。管理层表示，仍在扩大规模的更多新产品组合抑制了本季度的毛利率，而 Axon 在扩大反无人机和其他新业务时正在吸收这种组合。

现金也还没有到。 2026年上半年，Axon的自由现金流流出约5600万美元。管理层预计全年为4.5亿美元，第四季度季节性较强，因此下半年必须带来比全年指导更多的现金。管理层将现金疲软与 Axon 为满足需求而建立的库存挂钩，并预计 2026 年之后支出将放缓。

什么会减缓 Axon 的反无人机销售？

世界杯结束后需求可能会放缓，管理层称需求激增。 Axon 也只能赢得国土安全部计划的一小部分，尽管管理层表示该计划并不是将资金用于反无人机的唯一方式。利润率也可能首先下滑：在 2026 财年第二季度关税退款后，管理层在 8 月表示，预计 2026 财年第三季度调整后的 EBITDA 利润率为 Axon 将在 2026 年 11 月报告的四分之一，以反映更高的内存成本，没有关税退款，然后在第四季度再次上升

如果反无人机需求或现金不足，买家就只能持有股价为往绩市盈率 171.1 倍（而标准普尔 500 指数为 22.6 倍）的股票，而该公司利润微薄。迄今为止，反无人机需求已超过世界杯，但现金尚未到来，因此 Axon 预计在 2026 年 11 月发布的报告中的自由现金流数字值得关注。

现在您对 Axon Enterprise 有了更多的了解。我们的目的是告知您，以便您可以自行决定，对一只股票进行任何方向的操作都会带来风险。
